description.value: While raging, landing a hit with a blaster you're proficient with — using your Strength modifier on the damage roll — lets you spend a bonus action to close the distance: you may move up to half your speed toward the target you struck, ending that movement nearer to it than where you began. Should this bring you within 5 feet of the target, you can tack on a single melee attack with the same blaster as part of that bonus action.
